The '''''White Dwarf''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]].

==History==
After the evacuation of the [[Nespis VIII]] [[Nespis VIII|spaceport]], the ''White Dwarf'' checked in with the cruiser [[Republic (cruiser)|''Republic'']] to gain permission to join the exiled fleet. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] ordered it to pick up a position at coordinates one-zero-three and await new coordinates.
